fact: In its 13 February 2025 notification under the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement the Comoros classed Article 10.4 (single window) and Article 7.2 (electronic payment) as Category C with a definitive implementation date of 31 December 2026, and asked for help to establish a full electronic single window.
title: Notification of Category Commitments under the Agreement on Trade Facilitation, G/TFA/N/COM/1
publisher: Committee on Trade Facilitation, World Trade Organization
